heading: Get back into your account with WhatsApp
description: Cannot get into your account, and the reset email is no help because you have lost that inbox? If you saved a WhatsApp number, confirm a code we send to it. You can then choose a new password, or move your account to an email address you can actually read.
identify.label: Your email, in-game name or UID
identify.hint: Whichever one you would normally sign in with. We send a code to the WhatsApp number saved on that account.
identify.submit: Send me a code on WhatsApp
identify.reach: This only works if you saved a WhatsApp number on your account, and most people have not. If you did not, nothing will arrive:
code.label: The 6 digit code
code.hint: Check WhatsApp on the number saved on your account. The code works once and runs out in 10 minutes.
code.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
choose.provedFor: You are signed in to fix
choose.intro: That is you. What would you like to fix?
choose.passwordBody: You know your email, you just cannot remember your password.
choose.emailBody: The email on your account is wrong, or you cannot open that inbox any more.
choose.oneOnly: You can do one of these with this code. If you need both, come back and confirm a new code afterwards.
email.label: Your new email address
email.hint: Use an address you can open right now. We send a code to it, and your account only moves once you enter that code.
email.submit: Send a code to that address
emailCode.label: The 6 digit code from your new email
emailCode.hint: We sent it to {email}. Not right? Go back and fix it before you finish.
password.hint: Everyone signed in to this account will be signed out, and any device you told us to remember will be asked for its code again. If your account uses two-step sign-in, you will still need it to get in, so nothing about that changes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
